# Porter

> Porter gives startups and small businesses a finance team and modern accounting software. The Porter team handles bookkeeping and accounting, accounts receivable, accounts payable, payroll, taxes, and financial planning and analysis. Owners see current numbers and can ask questions in the Porter app, in Slack, by text, or in ChatGPT and Claude. Porter can be the accounting system or work alongside an existing QuickBooks Online account.

Porter is a managed service plus software. People on the Porter team do and approve the work.

## Services
- [What Porter does](https://buildwithporter.com/services): the six service areas
- [Books cleanup](https://buildwithporter.com/books-cleanup): catch-up bookkeeping in less than 2 weeks, then a monthly close. Porter does not prepare tax returns on this offer and does not replace your accountant.
- [Sale-ready books](https://buildwithporter.com/sale-ready): books cleaned up in less than 2 weeks and kept current until a sale closes
- [Multi-entity](https://buildwithporter.com/multi-entity): separate books per company and consolidated group reports, with activity between companies removed
- [Design studios](https://buildwithporter.com/design): client deposits, procurement fees and vendor orders kept straight
- [Financial health audit](https://buildwithporter.com/financial-health-audit): free guided checkup covering cash, profit, unpaid invoices and book quality
